tests.2: With n = 1 there are no pairs to compare, so no pass runs at all: passes=0.
tests.3: An already sorted array still takes one pass, which makes no swaps and stops.
tests.4: Reverse order: passes stop after pass n-2 at the latest.
tests.5: Swap only when a[j] > a[j+1], not >=, so equal values are not swapped.
